description: Resolution-statistics adaptation test (the 70% arm). Base: E090 code. Move the whitening-bias detach point from ~41% of samples (inside the 24 px phase) to ~70% of samples (inside the 32 px phase, after both the 28 and 32 px switches). Keep the bias LR schedule otherwise unchanged. Warm up the whiten_bias_grad=True graph variants for the 24 px bs-1536, 28 px bs-1024 and 32 px bs-1024 shapes in build on synthetic data. Change nothing else. Log the whitening-bias vector norm and its relative change across each resolution switch. Decide on off-seed seeds 3-26, paired against the E090 baseline, plus two distinct scored samples.
